svg.title: A board in its enclosure: room all round, and a critical edge
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of a 50 by 30 mm board inside an enclosure, with 1 mm of room all round. On the left edge, a small stub of a breakaway tab sticks out about 0.5 mm, shown enlarged on the right; the room around the board leaves space for it. The right edge is marked as critical, so the assembler routes it instead of scoring or tabbing it, holding it to about plus or minus 0.1 mm.

g.text: About 0.5 mm left by a breakaway tab
1 mm from the board all round
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm. Values from PCB-DFA-011.
Room: about 1 mm all round, 0.5 mm at the very least.
